summary: To remove a deprecated plugin from a collection, delete the file and related tests and docs, then add a tombstone entry with removal_version or removal_date (next major release) in meta/runtime.yml.
questions: How do I fully remove a deprecated module from my collection?

answer_card.title: Tombstone a plugin in a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Remove the module/plugin and related tests and docs.
2. Add to `meta/runtime.yml`:
```yaml
plugin_routing:
  modules:
    old_cloud:
      tombstone:
        removal_version: 2.0.0
        warning_text: Use foo.bar.new_cloud instead.
```
Or `removal_date` set to the next major release date.
